tasks.content:
Read .oneticket/templates/product-spec.md. Create apps/flashcards/docs/what/product-spec.md with:
- SITE_DESCRIPTION: 'Flashcard app for learning world capitals with flip mode and local progress tracking.'
- Vision: learn world capitals efficiently via spaced-repetition-ready flashcard system
- Users: learners studying geography
- Problems: memorization without structure, no progress tracking
- Product Goals: display cards from built-in theme, track session progress, extensible theme/mode architecture
- Out of Scope: backend, user accounts, spaced-repetition algorithm (structure only)
- Business Concepts: Theme, Card, LearningMode, SessionResult
- Product Capabilities: theme selection, flip interaction, session scoring, results summary
- Workflows: Home → Session → Results → replay
- Business Rules: no backend, localStorage only, algo in isolated hook
- Success Criteria: user can complete a session with score visible

Read .oneticket/templates/epic.md. Read apps/flashcards/docs/what/product-spec.md.
Create apps/flashcards/docs/what/epics/epic-0-mvp/epic.md:
- Goal: MVP flashcard app with World Capitals theme, flip mode, session scoring
- Business Value: enable structured memorization with immediate feedback
- Scope: Home screen (theme/mode selection), Session screen (flip + score buttons), Results screen (summary + replay)
- Related User Stories: leave placeholder sections for @analyst to fill after us-*.md are created

Read .oneticket/templates/us.md. Read apps/flashcards/docs/what/product-spec.md. Read apps/flashcards/docs/what/epics/epic-0-mvp/epic.md.
Create ALL 4 user stories in apps/flashcards/docs/what/epics/epic-0-mvp/user-stories/:

1. us-001-home-screen.md: 'As a learner, I want to select a theme and learning mode so that I can start a study session.' AC: theme picker shows World Capitals, mode selector shows flip, Start button navigates to /session.

2. us-002-session-flip.md: 'As a learner, I want to see a card and flip it to reveal the answer so that I can test my knowledge.' AC: card shows country name, tap/click flips to show capital, progress bar visible, I knew it / I didn't know buttons appear after flip.

3. us-003-results-screen.md: 'As a learner, I want to see my session score and replay option so that I can track my learning progress.' AC: score displays X/Y known, replay button restarts session, back to home option.

4. us-004-complete-flow.md: 'As a learner, I want to go through Home → Session → Results → replay so that I can study flashcards continuously.' AC: all 3 screens link correctly, session data persists in localStorage, replay resets session.

Each file gets Related Epic (epic-0-mvp.md) section.

Read apps/flashcards/docs/what/product-spec.md. Read all us-*.md files in apps/flashcards/docs/what/epics/epic-0-mvp/user-stories/.
Create apps/flashcards/docs/how/architecture.md with:
- Stack: React + Vite + TypeScript + MSW + localStorage
- AppShell as scaffold base, adapted for flashcards
- Screens: Home (/), Session (/session), Results (/results)
- Components: FlashcardDisplay, ThemePicker, ModeSelector, ProgressBar, ScoreButtons, SessionResults
- Key Types: LearningMode = 'flip' | 'spaced-repetition', Theme { id, name, cards }, Card { id, front, back }, SessionResult { cardId, known, timestamp }
- Routes: /, /session, /results
- Navigation: Home, About (remove Help, Demo)
- Hooks: useLearningMode (isolates algo logic), useTheme, useSession
- Constraints: no backend, localStorage only, algo in hook, GitHub Pages

Read apps/flashcards/docs/how/architecture.md.
Create apps/flashcards/docs/how/c4/system-context.md with Mermaid diagram:
- Person: Learner
- System: Flashcard App (React SPA on GitHub Pages)
- External: localStorage (browser), MSW (mock API)
- Interactions: Learner browses to app, selects theme/mode, studies cards, sees results

Read apps/flashcards/docs/how/architecture.md.
Create apps/flashcards/docs/how/c4/containers.md with Mermaid diagram:
- Web Application container: React SPA with client-side routing (/, /session, /results)
- State: React Context for session state, localStorage for persistence
- MSW handlers: theme data (world-capitals.json), session results
- Components: HomeScreen, SessionScreen, ResultsScreen, FlashcardDisplay, ThemePicker, ModeSelector

Read apps/flashcards/docs/how/architecture.md. Read all us-*.md in apps/flashcards/docs/what/epics/epic-0-mvp/user-stories/.
Create apps/flashcards/docs/how/slices/slice-1-foundation/slice.md:
- Vertical slice for project scaffold, routing, theme data, type definitions, core hooks
- Files: src/data/themes/world-capitals.json, src/types/index.ts, src/hooks/useLearningMode.ts, src/hooks/useTheme.ts, src/App.tsx routing setup, src/screens/HomeScreen.tsx (empty shell)

Create apps/flashcards/docs/how/slices/slice-2-home/slice.md:
- Vertical slice for Home screen implementation
- Files: src/screens/HomeScreen.tsx (theme picker, mode selector, Start button), AppShell nav adaptation

Create apps/flashcards/docs/how/slices/slice-3-session-results/slice.md:
- Vertical slice for Session + Results screens
- Files: src/screens/SessionScreen.tsx, src/screens/ResultsScreen.tsx, src/components/FlashcardDisplay.tsx, src/components/ScoreButtons.tsx, src/components/ProgressBar.tsx, src/hooks/useSession.ts

Read all slice files in apps/flashcards/docs/how/slices/ and all us-*.md in apps/flashcards/docs/what/epics/epic-0-mvp/user-stories/ and epic.md.
Update each file's ## Related Slices section with filename-only links:
- epic.md: add [Slice 1 — Foundation](slice-1-foundation/slice.md), [Slice 2 — Home](slice-2-home/slice.md), [Slice 3 — Session+Results](slice-3-session-results/slice.md)
- us-001-home-screen.md: add [Slice 2 — Home](slice-2-home/slice.md)
- us-002-session-flip.md: add [Slice 3 — Session+Results](slice-3-session-results/slice.md)
- us-003-results-screen.md: add [Slice 3 — Session+Results](slice-3-session-results/slice.md)
- us-004-complete-flow.md: add all slices
- Each slice.md: add [Epic 0 — MVP](../epics/epic-0-mvp/epic.md) and relevant US files

Write ONLY the ## Related Slices and ## Related Epics / ## Related User Stories sections — do not modify other content.
